move: circle stretches into search bar, types query, results stagger in, collapses
how: On a dark grid stage a single 84px circle with a magnifier icon sits at top centre. Cursor arrives in the first 12% of the 6s loop and presses at 0.7s (scale 0.92). At 0.82s the circle's width tweens 84 to 760px with expo.out over 0.7s while a scaleY 0.9 dip recovers with elastic.out(1,0.45) and the magnifier wiggles -20deg back to 0 elastically; the field and a ⌘K badge fade in. At 1.75s TextPlugin types 'design' over 0.6s with ease none while a caret blinks on 0.5s set calls; at 2.2s a results panel rises (y -14 to 0, scale 0.96 to 1, expo.out) and four rows stagger in 0.07s apart with power3.out. From 4.2s (70%) the rows drop out staggered from the end, the panel shrinks away, badge and field fade, the bar collapses back to 84px with expo.inOut over 0.6s, and typed text and placeholder are reset at 5.4s so the loop closes.
adapt: Change the placeholder, typed query, the four result rows and icons, and the open width; keep the 0.7s expo.out expand with the scaleY dip and the 0.07s row stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds grid, wrap with bar (mag svg, field with typed/ph/caret, kbd), results panel with rows and cursor inside el; register TextPlugin. animate returns the timeline with press at 0.117D, expand 0.137D, typing 0.29D, results 0.37D, collapse 0.7D to 0.9D. The caret blink loop of set() calls should be generated as fractions of D; scope selectors to el.
caveats: width tween on the bar triggers layout each frame
caret blink and text reset use .set() calls, fine for forward seek
